title: Are We Alone?
blurb: Three terms of the Drake equation are measured. Four are not, and they swing the answer by twenty-six orders of magnitude.
open: f_l, f_i, f_c and L have no observational constraint whatsoever. The module states this rather than hiding it in a default value.
f_l has exactly one data point and it is subject to an unavoidable selection effect.
No confirmed biosignature or technosignature has ever been detected.
